The Product Market Fit
MINI EXERCISE
I sell clean vegetables (my core product)
to_ middle and upper middle class customers in Jaipur and have them home delivered through a mobile app _ (my core customer)

My product / service solves C by posting regular video and photo streams of farms from where we buy and have then home delivered on a subscription model, for increased ease of purchase (how do you solve the problem)

slides.title: The Product Market Fit
slides.text:
The Product Market Fit
We sell customised commercial board wood furniture to customers like incubation centres, cafes, shops etc that have need for specialised furniture with high aesthetics. Such customers are not able to get custom furniture from organised players and have to depend on the local carpenter, with quality assurance compromised. We solve this problem by creating highly customisable designs that can be manufactured on CNC machines, thus enabling zero inventory and high degree of precision.
